skirmish.module.tnt_timer.name: TNT Timer
skirmish.module.tnt_timer.description: Seconds to the blast above primed TNT, plus its HolyWorld type (A, B, C4, B2, waves, stealers, long fuse) when the server gives it away. Only TNT in plain view: nothing shows through walls.
skirmish.module.tnt_timer.setting.show_t: The type's name next to the timer when it could be recognised
skirmish.module.tnt_timer.setting.max_di: No label on TNT farther than this
skirmish.module.tnt_timer.setting.radius: A ring on the ground around TNT in plain view: the wiki's blast power (plain 4, A 12, B 40, B2 a 25-block cube). Approximate, walls are not taken into account
